questions.stem: What does the anaesthetic machine do to the pressure of medical gases it receives?
options: Raises it to match the patient's airway pressure
Lowers it to a safe level
Keeps it at cylinder pressure throughout
Converts the gases into liquid before use

questions.stem: On the anaesthetic machine, what happens to the gases before a known vapour concentration is added?
questions.answer: They are mixed to a set composition and flow.
